Thanks Elena — quick internal note.

We have enough interviewers on the west-coast day schedule but this loop will start at 7:00am PT which is outside most folks' normal hours. Two asks:

1) Can we spin up a nightshift/proxy roster — two proxies who can own the first technical segment + hand off to day panel for debrief? Proxies will use a condensed rubric (we'll send) and guarantee the candidate experience.

2) If proxies cannot be full interviewers, we need a "wedge" coverage plan: one senior to take the interview and one EM/PM to join the debrief immediately afterward (shorter overlap).

Proposed volunteers: Markus, Kim — you both have done early calls before. If you can't do full coverage, please suggest someone to swap with. Marissa — can you liaise with CS to confirm candidate communication cadence and confirm we update Greenhouse with the agreed slot?

I'll assemble a brief proxy rubric and share the roster. If no internal volunteers by 11:30am PT I'll propose a paid external panelist (last resort).

Aisha
